scope: Development Supabase/PostgREST. Category fixtures are fictional. Ordinary user JWTs enforce provider/client RLS. Admin-generated links are exchanged in memory; no email is sent or password changed.
limitations: Does not query PostgreSQL RLS catalog flags. Category active_status is not a coverage-zone flag.

outcomes.test: Trusted admin: fictional categories and approved/draft mapping fixtures exist
Anonymous: active category visible; known inactive category hidden
Anonymous: approved-service mapping visible; known draft-service mapping hidden
Provider: real user session sees active categories and approved mappings only
Provider: category update and mapping insert are forbidden
Client: real user session sees active categories and approved mappings only
Client: category update and mapping insert are forbidden
Trusted admin: inactive category remains visible and administrative update succeeds
